capabilities: Zoom Mermaid diagrams with mouse wheel, buttons, and pinch gestures
Pan diagrams by click-and-drag or touch drag
Resize diagram containers by dragging edges and corners
Open diagrams in a fullscreen modal
Set a default initial zoom level (50-300%)
extras: Not yet available in the Obsidian community plugin browser; must be installed manually from GitHub Releases. Wheel zoom is off by default in the inline view and must be enabled per diagram; default zoom changes only apply to newly rendered diagrams.
intentEvidence: An Obsidian plugin that adds zoom and pan functionality to Mermaid diagrams.
problem: Obsidian renders Mermaid diagrams at a fixed size, so large or complex diagrams are hard to read without a way to zoom or pan.
summary: Zoom and pan controls for Mermaid diagrams, with mouse wheel, pinch gestures, drag panning, resizable containers, and a fullscreen mode.
